newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call rates slip on eve of reporting Friday.
newsitem.headline: Indian call rates slip on eve of reporting Friday.

text.p: Indian call money rates slipped to 4.75-5.75 percent in early deals on Thursday, down from the day's opening quote of 5.0-6.25 percent, dealers said.
The fall was expected as most banks have covered themselves ahead of the reporting Friday, dealers said.
They expect the rates to fall further during the day.
The comfortable liquidity situation has reined in call rates below the 11 percent mark in recent months.
